Canadian Space Agency on Instagram: "From the Earth to the Moon, the Artemis II test flight is humanity’s first crewed lunar mission in more than 50 years. 🌕 

This mission is often compared to Apollo 8 because, like Apollo 8, Artemis II will not land on the Moon. Apollo 8 entered lunar orbit and circled the Moon 10 times in 1968. Artemis II will be doing a lunar flyby of the far side of the Moon. It is the first crewed flight test of the Artemis program while Apollo 8 was preceded by missions that orbited the Earth to test the systems before sending humans to the Moon. 

CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen and his Artemis II crewmates will launch from Florida for a nearly 10-day journey."
